en: Vintage divided-back postcard with handwritten Spanish text on the left and address on the right. The printed heading at the top right says "Postkarte – Carte postale – Weltpostverein – Union postale universelle" followed by the word for postcard in many languages. There is a red stamp with a circular cancellation mark and a postmark. The card is addressed in blue ink to Sr. D. Benito Pérez Galdós at Hotel S. Quintín, La Magdalena, Santander. The left side contains a personal message in neat cursive handwriting signed "Alfredo Guadalupe".
